entries.title: Search the literature shortlists sources before writing findings
entries.body: On articles you own, Search the literature (under Where it sits) adds a step: the AI first shortlists what the searches gathered, then writes the findings from that shortlist. Each quote is still checked against everything gathered. If the shortlist names none of the gathered sources, you see a message and can try again, rather than empty findings.

entries.title: Where it sits shows its tools first
entries.body: On articles you own, Where it sits shows its tools as buttons at the top, each with its number of results when known, zero included. Its lists are renamed Papers that cite it and What it builds on, and each quoted passage in the findings takes you to that spot in the article.

entries.title: Guess first offers choices, revealed passage by passage
entries.body: In Where it sits, Guess first offers optional choices for your guess and reveals the answer one passage at a time. Evidence first shows the choice you made beside the search's own reading. Both are behind the Experimental features switch on your profile page.

entries.title: Where it sits shows only recorded publication years
entries.body: Where it sits could show a publication year that disagreed with Not cited; it now shows only the paper's recorded year, even when the year is all that is recorded. What it builds on no longer shows a title that only repeats the author and year. Long names at the top no longer hide the view buttons.
